swap.Parent and baby in the water together: s: Four children, one instructor, and the first big steps: kicking, floating and blowing bubbles.
swap.Each thirty-minute class is a parent and: Each thirty-minute class has four children and one instructor in the warm teaching pool. Parents watch from the viewing area while children learn to put their faces in, float on their own and kick across the pool with a noodle.
swap.Happy in the water, face wet and all: Putting their face in and blowing bubbles
swap.Floating on their back with help: Floating on their front and back
swap.Kicking and reaching for a toy: Kicking across the pool with a noodle
swap.Holding on to the wall on their own: Jumping in and turning back to the wall
swap.Safe ways to get in and out: Listening to the instructor in the water

swap.Parent and baby in the water together: s: From the first width to four strokes and safe treading water, at your child's own pace.
swap.Each thirty-minute class is a parent and: Each forty-five-minute class has four children working through eight levels, from the first unaided width to all four strokes. Swimmers move up when they're ready, and get a new level card each time they do.
swap.Happy in the water, face wet and all: Swimming a width, then a length, on their own
swap.Floating on their back with help: Front crawl and backstroke with good breathing
swap.Kicking and reaching for a toy: Treading water for a full minute
swap.Holding on to the wall on their own: Safe entries, including from the deep end
swap.Safe ways to get in and out: Breaststroke and butterfly in the top levels

swap.Parent and baby in the water together: s: Turns, starts and stamina for swimmers getting ready to join a team.
swap.Each thirty-minute class is a parent and: Each forty-five-minute session in the lane pool works on starts from the block, tumble turns, pacing and stamina. Swimmers get a short plan to practise between sessions, and a tryout checklist at the end of the term.
swap.Happy in the water, face wet and all: Dives and starts from the block
